model: 微调 SQL 模型（Qwen3.5-9B QLoRA）

rows.question: 9 月各渠道的 GMV 和订单数
rows.sql: SELECT ch.channel_name, SUM(o.pay_amount) AS gmv, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt FROM fact_orders o JOIN dim_channel ch ON o.channel_id = ch.channel_id WHERE o.dt BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY ch.channel_name ORDER BY gmv DESC

rows.question: 列出 9 月各区域的 GMV 和订单数
rows.sql: SELECT r.region_name, SUM(o.pay_amount) AS gmv, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt FROM fact_orders o JOIN dim_region r ON o.region_id = r.region_id WHERE o.dt BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY r.region_name ORDER BY gmv DESC

rows.question: 9 月信息流广告每天的访客数
rows.sql: SELECT f.dt, SUM(f.uv) AS uv FROM fact_traffic_daily f JOIN dim_channel ch ON f.channel_id = ch.channel_id WHERE ch.channel_name = '信息流广告' AND f.dt BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY f.dt ORDER BY f.dt

rows.question: 9 月家电类目 GMV 最高的 5 个商品
rows.sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(i.pay_amount) AS gmv FROM fact_order_items i JOIN fact_orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN dim_product p ON i.product_id = p.product_id JOIN dim_category c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.category_name = '家电' AND o.dt BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY gmv DESC LIMIT 5

rows.question: 8 月和 9 月的支付转化率分别是多少
rows.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT SUM(uv) AS uv FROM fact_traffic_daily WHERE dt BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'), n AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM fact_orders WHERE dt BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'), m AS (SELECT SUM(uv) AS uv FROM fact_traffic_daily WHERE dt BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'), o AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM fact_orders WHERE dt BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30') SELECT t.uv * 1.0 / n.n AS cvr_aug, m.uv * 1.0 / o.n AS cvr_sep FROM t, n, m, o

rows.question: 9 月新客订单占比是多少
rows.sql: SELECT SUM(is_new_user) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS new_user_share FROM fact_orders WHERE dt BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'

rows.question: 9 月各渠道的营收和佣金分别是多少
rows.sql: SELECT ch.channel_name, SUM(f.net_revenue) AS revenue, SUM(f.commission_amount) AS commission FROM fact_commission_monthly f JOIN dim_channel ch ON f.channel_id = ch.channel_id WHERE f.month = '2026-09' GROUP BY ch.channel_name ORDER BY revenue DESC

rows.question: 9 月各产品线的营收和毛利率
rows.sql: SELECT s.product_line, SUM(f.net_revenue) AS revenue, SUM(f.net_revenue - f.unit_cogs * f.sales_qty) / SUM(f.net_revenue) AS gross_margin FROM fact_sales_daily f JOIN dim_sku s ON f.sku_id = s.sku_id WHERE f.dt BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY s.product_line

rows.question: 6 月到 9 月每个月的净利率
rows.sql: SELECT f.dt AS month, SUM(f.net_revenue) AS revenue, SUM(f.sales_qty * c.unit_cogs) AS cost, SUM(f.net_revenue - f.sales_qty * c.unit_cogs) / SUM(f.net_revenue) AS gross_margin, SUM(l.logistics_cost) AS logistics, SUM(co.commission_amount) AS commission, SUM(m.amount) AS marketing, SUM(f.net_revenue - f.sales_qty * c.unit_cogs - l.logistics_cost - co.commission_amount - m.amount) / SUM(f.net_revenue) AS net_margin FROM fact_sales_daily f JOIN fact_sku_cost_monthly c ON f.sku_id = c.sku_id AND f.dt BETWEEN c.month || '-01' AND c.month || '-30' JOIN fact_logistics_daily l ON f.dt = l.dt AND f.channel_id = l.channel_id JOIN fact_commission_monthly co ON f.dt BETWEEN co.effective_from AND co.effective_to AND f.channel_id = co.channel_id JOIN fact_marketing_monthly m ON f.dt BETWEEN m.month || '-01' AND m.month || '-30' AND f.channel_id = m.channel_id WHERE f.dt BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY f.dt ORDER BY f.dt

rows.question: 9 月社区团购渠道的折扣率
rows.sql: SELECT SUM(discount_amount) * 1.0 / SUM(gross_amount) AS discount_rate FROM fact_sales_daily WHERE channel_id = (SELECT channel_id FROM dim_channel WHERE channel_name = '社区团购') AND dt BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
